name: After recital F
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Fa. whereas housing policy must respect cultural identity, architectural heritage and landscape quality; whereas traditional building crafts, local materials and regionally adapted architectural forms contribute to sustainability and cultural diversity; whereas regionally adapted construction practices contribute to affordability, resilience and sustainability, particularly in outermost, rural and border regions; whereas housing constitutes a lasting part of Europe’s cultural, social and architectural heritage;
